question: What is the Andre Norton Aword?
answer: The Andre Norton Award for Young Adult Science Fiction and Fantasy is an annual award presented by the Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers of America (SFWA) to the author of the best young adult or middle grade science fiction or fantasy book published in the United States in the preceding year. It is named to honor prolific science fiction and fantasy author Andre Norton (1912–2005). The award was established by then SFWA president Catherine Asaro and the SFWA Young Adult Fiction committee and announced on February 20, 2005. Any published young adult or middle grade science fiction or fantasy novel is eligible for the prize, including graphic novels, with no limit on word count. The award is presented along with the Nebula Awards and follows the same rules for nominations and voting; works may be simultaneously nominated for both the Andre Norton Award and a Nebula Award.
